verdict.rationale: Data-use and privacy posture is a fair question for an app that can sync user secrets to a Google cloud account, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence addresses AI model training or any opt-out from it. The 'Use without an account' local mode and the encryption claims are adjacent privacy controls, not a documented AI-training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
